title: 聊天｜成功率与首发失败
description: 用户视角成功率与首发平台+模型失败率（报错/中断/拒答/超时）。数据：st_chat_turns_total。

list.name: lane
list.label: 栏目
list.query: 全部 : chat|free_zone, 付费聊天 : chat, 畅聊 : free_zone

list.name: fail_type
list.label: 失败类型
list.query: 全部 : error|interrupted|refused|timeout, 报错 : error, 中断 : interrupted, 拒答 : refused, 超时 : timeout

panels.title: 用户成功率
panels.description: 用户视角：首发 + 首字兜底 + 出字后重写共同作用之后，用户最终拿到正常回答的比例。不计余额/VIP 拒绝和用户停止。

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"}[$__range]) * 0)) / sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0))

panels.title: 首发成功率
panels.description: 首发模型自己的表现。报错：出字前就失败（含由兜底交付的）；中断：出字后卡住/流内错误/断开/被截断；拒答：正文开头命中运营词池或供应商内容过滤；超时：首字兜底真正替它交付，或谁都没出字。

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"}[$__range]) * 0)) / sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0))

panels.title: 聊天轮数
panels.description: 时间范围内用户发起的聊天（含重新生成）。

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0))

panels.title: 兜底救回的轮数
panels.description: 首发失败、由首字兜底或出字后重写救回、用户最终拿到正常回答的轮数。

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue!="none"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue!="none"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue!="none"}[$__range]) * 0))

panels.title: 成功率走势（近 1 小时滚动）
panels.description: 用户成功率 vs 首发成功率；两条线之间的差就是兜底救回的部分。

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"}[1h]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"} offset 1h or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success"}[1h]) * 0)) / sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[1h]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset 1h or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[1h]) * 0))

sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"}[1h]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"} offset 1h or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="success"}[1h]) * 0)) / sum(last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[1h]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset 1h or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[1h]) * 0))

panels.title: 视图 1 · 每个模型的用户失败率（直接对应用户体验）
每个模型的用户失败率（按失败类型分色）
panels.description: 用户视角：首发 + 首字兜底 + 出字后重写共同作用之后，用户最终没拿到正常回答的比例。 模型按用户所选模型对应的首发平台 + 模型列出；受顶部「失败类型」筛选。

targets.expr: label_join(label_replace(((sum by (platform, model, outcome) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome=~"$fail_type"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome=~"$fail_type"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome=~"$fail_type"}[$__range]) * 0))) or label_replace(0 * sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)), "outcome", "none", "", "")) / on (platform, model) group_left sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)), "m", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)"), "pm", " · ", "platform", "m")

panels.title: 首发 + 兜底共同作用
panels.description: 同一模型：首发自己失败多少、首字兜底和出字后重写各救回多少轮、用户最终还剩多少失败。

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)), "model", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)")

label_replace(((sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome!="success"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome!="success"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome!="success"}[$__range]) * 0))) or (0 * sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)))) / sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)), "model", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)")

label_replace(sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue="fallback"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue="fallback"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue="fallback"}[$__range]) * 0)), "model", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)")

label_replace(sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue="rewrite"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue="rewrite"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome="success", rescue="rewrite"}[$__range]) * 0)), "model", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)")

label_replace(((sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome!="success"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome!="success"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", outcome!="success"}[$__range]) * 0))) or (0 * sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)))) / sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)), "model", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)")

panels.title: 视图 2 / 3 · 首发模型失败率（左：哪个最差　右：差在哪）
首发模型失败率（从高到低）
panels.description: 首发模型自己的表现。报错：出字前就失败（含由兜底交付的）；中断：出字后卡住/流内错误/断开/被截断；拒答：正文开头命中运营词池或供应商内容过滤；超时：首字兜底真正替它交付，或谁都没出字。 选「全部」按四类分色堆叠，条长 = 总失败率；选单类时只比该类。

targets.expr: label_join(label_replace(((sum by (platform, model, primary_outcome) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"}[$__range]) * 0))) or label_replace(0 * sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)), "primary_outcome", "none", "", "")) / on (platform, model) group_left sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} offset $__range or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__range]) * 0)), "m", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)"), "pm", " · ", "platform", "m")

panels.title: 视图 2 / 3 随时间（哪个模型、几点开始、现在还在不在）
首发失败率 · 按小时（行 = 平台 · 模型）
panels.description: 首发模型自己的表现。报错：出字前就失败（含由兜底交付的）；中断：出字后卡住/流内错误/断开/被截断；拒答：正文开头命中运营词池或供应商内容过滤；超时：首字兜底真正替它交付，或谁都没出字。 每格是那一小时（整点起）的失败率，最右一格是当前未满的一小时；受顶部「失败类型」「栏目」筛选；空格 = 那一小时没有调用，「·」= 0。

targets.expr: label_replace(((sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"} or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) * 0))) or (0 * sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) * 0)))) / sum by (platform, model) (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"} or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) * 0)), "model", "$1", "model", "(?:.*/)?(.*)")

panels.title: 首发失败次数 · 按小时（按失败类型堆叠，全部模型）
panels.description: 每小时各类首发失败的次数（所有首发模型合计），看哪类失败在什么时候放量；受顶部筛选。

targets.expr: sum (last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="error", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) - (st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="error", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"} or last_over_time(st_chat_turns_total{deployment_environment_name="production", lane=~"$lane", primary_outcome="error", primary_outcome=~"$fail_type"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval) * 0))

options.content:
- **一次调用** = 用户发起的一轮聊天（含重新生成）；余额/VIP 拒绝、用户主动停止不计。
- **用户失败**：首发 + 首字兜底 + 出字后重写之后，用户最终仍是报错、中断、拒答或超时。
- **首发失败**：报错＝出字前失败（含由兜底交付）；中断＝出字后卡住（运营配置 stall_ms）、流内错误、断开或被截断；拒答＝正文开头 check_chars 个字命中运营平台「出字后兜底」词池，或供应商内容过滤；超时＝首字兜底真正替它交付，或谁都没出字。
- 平台 + 模型取用户所选模型对应的首发。数据来自后端指标 `st_chat_turns_total`（2026-11-24 起），按区间末值减起点值计数（不用 increase，避免漏掉新组合的第一条）。
- 阈值：单类 <2% 绿、2–5% 黄、≥5% 红；总失败率与成功率卡片另有阈值。
